labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in the root docs and asks how to contribute the fix.

body:
Describe the broken link and the fix in this issue, naming the page and link, and wait for a maintainer to approve it before opening a pull request. [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) requires a pull request to link an issue or discussion that a maintainer has approved, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) describes the process. This thread can't give a timeline. Related: #4029 asked the same question and is closed.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
